answer_1.quote: In this work, we study the problem of generating coherent, much longer passages of text (e.g., 1000 tokens)... We evaluate on two text generation domains including: (1) CNN News for unconditional generation. (2) Writing-Prompts for conditional story generation.
answer_1.outputs: Long passages of text (up to ~1000 tokens)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate with a broad array of automatic metrics, including lexical-based quality metrics and semantic-based quality metrics. MS-Jaccard (MSJ)... TF-IDF Distance (TID)... Fréchet BERT Distance (FBD)... Backward BLEU (B-BLEU)... Harmonic BLEU (HA-BLEU).

answer_4.quote: In our human study, we asked three university students who are proficient English speakers to evaluate the coherence and fluency of the generated text. Human raters assign a coherence score to each full-length text sample, on a 5-point Likert scale. ... label each sentence in the text passage with 0 or 1 ... evaluate the language quality for a fluency score on a 5-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were instructed to score passage-level coherence, sentence-level coherence, and fluency using 5-point Likert scales (and binary labels for sentence coherence).
